products.name: AXE post
products.description:
Rugged. Economical. Built for municipal realities.

SIGNEL AXE systems offer a rugged, economical and standardized solution for installing road signage and municipal equipment. Designed for the needs of cities and urban work zones, AXE posts allow signs, electronic equipment and street name brackets to be installed quickly and flexibly.
Already adopted by several Quebec municipalities, AXE systems are built around durability, versatility and excellent long-term value.

Available in 8′ 6 », 10′ or 12′ with a painted or galvanized finish, or both.

products.name: High-visibility medallion

Customization available with your logo, your message or your visual identity.

products.name: Used portable lockout box
products.description:
This product is used. Condition and appearance may differ slightly from the photo.

Portable lockout box

Used to hold and safely transport the equipment for a multiple lockout. Includes a protector for the lockout tag.

——

  • During water main work, several safety steps have to be carried out to prevent a section being put back into service by accident.
  • The safety cover lets the worker operate the valves from the surface, so there is no need to enter a confined space and no risk of falling in.
  • Once the valve is closed, the lockout device is placed in the opening of the valve chamber.
  • That precaution stops human error from putting workers' safety at risk.

products.name: UltraFlex T-RV-10 bollard
products.description:
Designed to mark out lanes and protect pedestrians, the UltraFlex absorbs impacts by flexing temporarily, then springs straight back to its original shape.
Made from a treated high-performance polymer, it stands up to North American weather conditions and to repeated impacts.

This model meets the standards of the Ministère des Transports du Québec (MTQ) for use on work zones.

Its anti-UV coating keeps its colour over time, while its yellow diamond-grade reflective bands (ASTM D4956) give excellent visibility by day and by night.

Ideal for urban areas, car parks or tight spaces, the UltraFlex is the simple, long-lasting way to make things safer for everyone using the road.

SIGNEL GUARD «TL0»

Lightweight barrier AB500

The Signel Guard TL0 is a galvanized steel safety barrier for temporary or long-term use in low-speed work zones.

Description

■ Modular galvanized steel safety system
■ For temporary or long-term use in low-speed work zones
■ Self-anchoring when a vehicle strikes a delineation
■ Installed on the ground, with or without anchors
■ Installed with or without fencing
■ Can be preassembled for quick deployment
■ Easily reconfigured by hand (x2)
■ Corner units available (45º and 90º)

Installed on the ground with or without anchors or fencing, this system is used to:
• Fence off storage areas, a yard or car parks
• Mark out a parking space
• Create a pedestrian walkway through a work zone
• Protect work zones in urban settings
• Mark out traffic lanes
• Route traffic around an obstacle

The Signel Guard is available to buy and to rent, whether for a week or several months.

Our barrier is a sound investment, and it can be customized for information, advertising or anything else.
We can add your logo, a telephone number or your company name so your equipment is always recognisable. Reflective bands make the work zone more visible to drivers.

products.description:
• Concave delineator or bollard
  • Black polymer
  • HI retroreflective sheeting on both faces
  • Supplied with a round adhesive mounting base
  • Supplied separately:
    • Epoxy kit ->AR1007F)
    • anchor kit, lag screws, washers, plugs, ->AR1021
  • Specify background colour: _____________
  • Specify message: _______________

—————-

The pedestrian crossing delineator is there to get your crossings respected.

Its design reminds drivers of their obligation to give way to pedestrians stepping onto a crossing.

What is more, placing the pedestrian crossing delineator in the centre of the roadway creates an obstacle that narrows the street and changes how drivers behave. That new sense of the space leads drivers to slow down.

If a vehicle strikes it, the delineator bends under the impact and then returns to its original position. It is built to survive any impact, even when hit at more than 80 km/h. Its rubber base lets it take the weight of heavy vehicles, even when a wheel runs straight over it.

This delineator can now be used on Ministère des Transports du Québec roads (Tome V – Standard 2.28.9, pedestrian delineator).

DIMENSIONS

Overall height: 48'' (1220mm)

Width: 12.75” (324mm)

Depth: 15.75'' (400 mm)

Width of the reflective sheeting: 12'' (305 mm)

products.name: In-street speed reduction sign / bollard
products.description:
• Concave delineator or bollard
  • Black polymer
  • HI retroreflective sheeting on both faces
  • Supplied with a round adhesive mounting base
  • Supplied separately:
    • Epoxy kit ->AR1007F)
    • anchor kit, lag screws, washers, plugs, ->AR1021
  • Specify background colour: _____________
  • Specify message: _______________

———————–

The speed reduction delineator is a simple, effective and inexpensive way to bring vehicle speeds down by 5 to 20 km/h.
It narrows the street and changes how drivers behave. A new sense of the space leads drivers to slow down.

Unlike a speed hump, this delineator does not slow emergency vehicles, and it encourages drivers into a low, steady speed. That style of driving keeps noise, air pollution and fuel use down.
If a vehicle strikes it, the delineator bends under the impact and then returns to its original position. It is built to survive any impact, even when hit at more than 80 km/h. Its rubber base lets it take the weight of heavy vehicles, even when a wheel runs straight over it.
In short, here are the 5 advantages of our speed reduction delineator over speed humps:
– It keeps noise down
– It does not slow emergency vehicles
– It creates no vibration
– It reduces air pollution and fuel use
– It creates no snow-clearing problem, because the delineators are taken away over the winter.

DIMENSIONS

  • Width of the reflective sheeting: 12'' (305 mm)

products.name: Hood for flagger winter coat, waterproof polyurethane-laminated polyester
products.description:
Hood for the AV103 flagger winter coat. This waterproof hood is made from 300-denier polyester yarn laminated with polyurethane. The polyester yarn is woven in an Oxford pattern. The finished material is 5 mm thick. The seams are glued and heat-sealed to keep them waterproof. It has two large clear side windows and closes with drawcords.

Pioneer manufacturer code: V1190560-O/S, model 6037H.

This hood, made of polyester laminated on the inside with polyurethane , is built from 300-denier yarn. In plainer terms, it is a mid-weight hood: light enough to be comfortable and heavy enough to give proper protection. By definition, 300 denier is the weight of 9,000 m of the yarn used, so 300 denier works out to 300 g.

As for the term Oxford, that is the type of weave. Oxford is widely used in the industry, for shirts, coats, bags and the like. An Oxford weave is made by crossing a weft yarn (horizontal) with a warp yarn (vertical) to create the checked look it is known for.

Fluorescent yellow (safety yellow-green) is highly visible in daylight and in low natural light, at dawn and dusk for instance. In most situations it also stands out sharply against the background. Fluorescent yellow, paler than orange, is more visible at night, though not as visible in the dark as reflective stripes.

Care:
This waterproof hood is machine washable on the delicate cycle in cold or warm water with a mild detergent. Do not use bleach or fabric softener. It should be air dried out of direct sunlight. This hood must never be tumble dried, ironed or dry cleaned.

products.name: Unlined high-visibility orange coverall
products.description:
High-visibility orange coverall by Terra®, unlined, made from 190 g polyester (65%) and cotton (35%).

Sizes available: small to 5XL. Please make your choice from the drop-down menu above.

Terra manufacturer code: 116581OR.

Meets CSA standard Z96-22 Class 3 – level 2

Features:
2 chest pockets, one with a snap-button flap, 2 side openings for access to the trousers underneath, 2 back pockets, 1 loop and 1 deep gusseted pocket on the back of the leg. Concealed two-way nylon zip at the front with a snap-button flap, nylon zip on the outside of each leg.

Adjustable cuff with a snap button, triple stitching to reinforce the front and back crotch, elasticated waist for a better fit, pleats at the back for freedom of movement.

2 in reflective stripes on 4 in contrasting bands (2 vertical lines on the chest, an "X" on the back, bands around the waist and arms and 2 bands on the legs).

Fluorescent orange is highly visible in daylight and where there is plenty of artificial light. In most situations it also stands out sharply against the background. Fluorescent orange is less visible at night, though, and in low natural or artificial light, at dawn or dusk for instance.

Silver-grey retroreflective stripes are highly visible in low natural or artificial light, because they bounce light back towards its source (a flashlight, car headlights and so on). They therefore give the most safety at dawn, at dusk and at night. They do not improve visibility during the day.

Use:
Ideal for workers on road work zones or in any related field.

Restriction:
Keep away from fire.

Care and service life:
Clean the coverall regularly, as dirt can reduce its high-visibility properties and its level of retroreflection. Users should check the coverall is in good condition before and after each use and clean it to make sure it stays clean, sound and free of signs of wear. Wash in cold water with a mild detergent, delicate cycle only. Hang to dry. Do not wring. Do not use bleach. Do not iron. Do not dry clean.

products.name: 6-in-1 high-visibility winter coat, fluorescent orange with retroreflective stripes, Class 2 Level 2
products.description:
6-in-1 high-visibility waterproof winter coat, fluorescent orange with silver retroreflective stripes.
Made by TERRA. Manufacturer model: 11-6562OR.

This winter coat has a removable, reversible liner with removable sleeves. It can be worn six ways:
1. High-visibility winter coat: shell with liner;
2. High-visibility rain jacket: shell on its own;
3. High-visibility three-season coat: liner on its own, with sleeves;
4. Black three-season coat: liner turned inside out, with sleeves;
5. High-visibility vest: liner on its own, without sleeves;
6. Black vest: liner turned inside out, without sleeves.

Ideal for anyone working near moving vehicles: drivers and workers in construction, petrochemicals, mining and fisheries.

This fluorescent orange coat has silver retroreflective stripes 2 inches (5 cm) wide, framed by fluorescent yellow bands 1 inch (2.5 cm) wide. The shell and the removable liner each have two vertical stripes at the front, two crossed stripes in an X at the back, one horizontal stripe at the waist and one stripe around each arm at the elbow.

Standards compliance:

  • Shell and liner with sleeves: meet Canadian standard CSA Z96-15 High-visibility safety apparel, class 2 level 2. Wide body coverage suited to medium-risk work.
  • Liner without sleeves (vest): meets Canadian standard CSA Z96-15 class 2. For low- or medium-risk work.
  • When the shell or the liner is worn with CSA-compliant high-visibility trousers with reflective stripes: the whole outfit meets Canadian standard CSA Z96-15 class 3. Full coverage of the body and all limbs, for high-risk work.
    High-visibility trousers are not included with this coat.
  • This coat is not flame resistant.

Materials:
The waterproof, windproof shell has two layers. The outer layer is 100% fluorescent orange polyester, 300 denier, polyurethane coated on the inside face. The inner layer is fluorescent orange polyester mesh, for comfort and better airflow. All seams are sealed and waterproof.

The coat's liner also has two layers. Like the shell, the outer layer is 100% fluorescent orange polyester, 300 denier, polyurethane coated on the inside face. The inner layer is 100% black polyester with a PVC coating. The liner is polyester padded.

Shell features:
The shell closes with a two-way plastic zip, protected by a flap with metal snap buttons. The hem and the cuffs have elasticated knit trim, which keeps the coat sitting closed against the wind.

The shell has two slanted outside pockets, two large inside pockets and two small inside pockets for instruments, phones and so on. The outside pockets do not close. The inside pockets close with hook-and-loop (Velcro) fastening.

The shell has a hood with a drawcord. The hood rolls away into the collar when it is not being worn.

Removable liner features:
The coat's removable, reversible liner closes with a reversible zip and no protective flap. The liner's collar is elasticated knit for comfort.

The liner has two slanted outside pockets, two outside pockets with flaps and two inside pockets without flaps.

The liner's sleeves are elasticated at the wrist. The sleeves come off with zips, so the liner can be worn as a vest.

About high-visibility colours:
Fluorescent orange is highly visible in daylight and where there is plenty of artificial light. In most situations it also gives strong contrast against the background. Fluorescent orange is, however, less visible at night and in low natural or artificial light, at dawn or dusk for instance.

Silver-grey retroreflective stripes are highly visible in low natural or artificial light because they bounce light back towards its source (a flashlight, car headlights and so on). They therefore give the most safety at dawn, at dusk and at night. They do not improve visibility during the day.

Care:
Machine wash on the delicate cycle in cold or warm water with a mild detergent. Do not use bleach, chlorine bleach or fabric softener. Air dry out of direct sunlight. Do not tumble dry. Do not iron. Do not dry clean.

products.name: High-visibility yellow polyester waterproof flagger coat, compliant with Transports Québec standards (XS to 4XL)
products.description:
High-visibility waterproof coat for flaggers. This product meets standard P4.34.1 issued by Transports Québec for road work zone signage.

This coat comes in sizes from extra small (XS) to quadruple extra large (4XL). Please choose your size from the drop-down menu above.

Pioneer manufacturer code: V1190360, model 6037.

This fluorescent yellow flagger coat meets the Transports Québec standard that came into force in December 2014. It also meets CSA Z96-15, class 2 when worn on its own and class 3 when worn with the matching high-visibility waterproof flagger trousers (see product VP19).

This polyester Oxford rain coat is made from 300-denier yarn. The inside of the coat is polyurethane coated to make it waterproof. The manufacturer rates it at 5000 mm, meaning the coat withstands a 5 m column of water. The waterproof rating is obtained by pressurising the fabric with a cylinder of water, in this case filled to a height of 5 m. That height is the point at which the first drops come through the fabric.

All the seams are taped and heat-sealed. The inside of the coat is fully lined with mesh fabric for comfort.

Reflective stripes and visibility:
This waterproof coat has silver retroreflective stripes alternating with fluorescent orange bands. Each band is 50 mm (2 in) wide. The coat has two vertical stripes at the front, two crossed stripes in an X at the back, three horizontal stripes at the waist and three stripes around the elbows. The collar is fluorescent orange as well.

Fluorescent yellow (safety yellow-green) is highly visible in daylight and in low natural light, at dawn and dusk for instance. In most situations it also stands out sharply against the background. Fluorescent yellow, paler than orange, is more visible at night, though not as visible in the dark as reflective stripes.

Fluorescent orange is highly visible in daylight and where there is plenty of artificial light. In most situations it also stands out sharply against the background. Fluorescent orange is less visible at night, though, and in low natural or artificial light, at dawn or dusk for instance.

Silver retroreflective stripes are highly visible in low natural or artificial light, because they bounce light back towards its source (a flashlight, car headlights and so on). They therefore give the most safety at dawn, at dusk and at night. They do not, on the other hand, improve visibility during the day.

Design:
The rain coat closes at the front with a plastic-tooth zip protected by a flap that fastens with hook-and-loop. It has vents under the arms, adjustable with zips, to keep it comfortable in warm weather. The coat has a front pocket for pens and other small items, a clear pocket for ID cards and a tab on each shoulder for clipping on a radio transmitter.

This polyester Oxford coat, polyurethane laminated on the inside, is made from 300-denier yarn. In plainer terms, it is a mid-weight coat: light enough to be comfortable and heavy enough to give proper protection. By definition, 300 denier is the weight of 9,000 m of the yarn used, so 300 denier works out to 300 g. The manufacturer, Pioneer®, is not able to give the thickness of the polyurethane lamination.

As for the term Oxford, that is the type of weave. Oxford is widely used in the industry, for shirts, coats, bags and the like. An Oxford weave is made by crossing a weft yarn (horizontal) with a warp yarn (vertical) to create the checked look it is known for.

Waterproofing:
Polyurethane-coated waterproof garments are generally worn by workers at low risk of chemical splashes. Polyurethane is a light, porous material. It makes light, breathable garments possible. In torrential rain with strong winds, though, polyurethane saturates with water and loses its waterproofing. Once soaked, polyurethane lets water through to the inside of the coat under the slightest pressure, from bending over or leaning against something for instance. Given the work flaggers do, a rain coat that breathes as much as possible is a must.

Care:
This waterproof coat is machine washable on the delicate cycle in cold or warm water with a mild detergent. Do not use bleach or fabric softener. It should be air dried out of direct sunlight. This coat must never be tumble dried, ironed or dry cleaned.

products.name: School corridor sign
products.description:
A school corridor is:

  • designated streets that pupils take to get to school.
  • traffic slowed by pedestrian crossings, speed bumps, curb extensions, drop-off areas and so on.

In most cases these school corridors lead to a crossing supervised by a crossing guard. The aim is to encourage children to take safe routes and to remind drivers to take extra care in the zones marked as school corridors. To reinforce that, we offer signs to put up in these zones alongside the "school corridor" sign

Description:

The signs we offer are:

  • Engineer grade reflective, anti-graffiti laminated, on 2.1 mm aluminum

products.name: Programming software – CGEpro
products.description:
HOW THE CGE SYSTEM WORKS

– Set up by software. Signel equipment management centres (CGE) are made up of a keypad and a control box. The control box has 11 to 28 outputs and 2 to 8 inputs depending on your needs and the model chosen. The outputs can be programmed in four modes: toggle, pulse, periodic or alternating. The software allows advanced programming of every parameter, so the system adapts to a great many configurations. A second keypad can be used, with the same functions or with complementary ones. The system can also have internal inputs (battery voltage, ambient temperature, current) that drive the outputs according to their state. The software makes it easy to view a configuration, to save configurations, and to pick up programming already in place. A similar installation therefore takes less time to programme. To get the software free of charge, write to: cgepro@signel.ca
